description:
Which S&P 500 stocks have moved together: trailing daily-return correlation.

    Measured data only: the Pearson correlation of each pair's recent actual
    daily returns, with `generated_at`, `scan_date` and `stale`. Tickers with
    no usable price history are listed in `missing`, never imputed. `top_n` is
    the universe size (first N tickers alphabetically); `ticker` returns only
    that ticker's row. Same payload as REST `GET /api/v1/market/correlations`.
name: get_market_correlations
